name: settings-skills-merged
note: UAT batch 6 ('can't we merge skills and agent accordion? A skilled export includes everything... users shouldn't have to copy prompts, paste them back and forward'). RED-FIRST vs main: Settings had a separate AI Agent accordion whose 'Export agent bundle' called the IDENTICAL downloadBundle as the Skills section's 'Export all skills' (songbook.js:6897 and :6932) - one zip, two names, two sections - beside a 'Copy starter prompt' button whose existence was the tell that the bundle was not self-describing. Now: one accordion, one export, and the docs demoted to a closed disclosure. Seeds real evidence through Competency.recordEvidence so the export row (gated on hasData) actually renders - a fresh device shows Import only, which would let a naive assert pass while proving nothing.

steps.label: seed one real evidence record through the app's own API so the export row is reachable
steps.js: (function(){var C=window.Competency;if(!C)return false;var fw=C.FRAMEWORKS[0];var c=(C.getProfile(fw.id).competencies||[])[0];if(!c)return false;C.recordEvidence(fw.id,c.id,{at:new Date().toISOString()});return C.hasData()===true;})()

steps.label: there is no separate AI Agent accordion any more - the whole job lives in one section
and the retired section left no orphan behind - no .accSec carries data-acc=agent
the agent block is ADOPTED into the Skills pane (it is re-appended on every render - an adoption done once at mount is wiped by the pane clear, which is exactly the bug this catches)
ONE export in the whole sheet, named for what it produces rather than our internals
steps.js: (function(){var lbls=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#settingsBody .setAction .saLbl')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim();});var exports=lbls.filter(function(t){return /export/i.test(t);});return exports.length===1&&exports[0]==='Export for my AI';})()

steps.label: the copy-a-prompt step is gone entirely - not relocated. Its existence was the tell that the zip did not describe itself
the docs are a DISCLOSURE, not a step: closed by default, so the shortest path is Export and nothing else
opening it still reveals everything a curious user wants - nothing was removed, only demoted
steps.js: (function(){var d=document.querySelector('.agentDisclose');if(!d||!d.open)return false;var l=[].slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.setAction .saLbl')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim();});return l.indexOf('Open AGENTS.md')>=0&&l.indexOf('Open capabilities.json')>=0&&l.indexOf('Copy doc links')>=0;})()

steps.label: the disclosure summary composes the same action-row primitive as the rows it reveals
no horizontal overflow at 412 with the merged section
